questions: « this remark does not extend » (l.928). Reading taken: there are two hyperbolic (Gamma_p, l(p))-circles that are not isomorphic but whose underlying RP1-circles are isomorphic, i.e. whose lifted holonomies are conjugate in G~ (GX.rp1Iso_iff_conj). Proved: GX.exists_positive_negative, GX.exists_rp1Iso_not_isIso. In the examples the Gamma_p-holonomies are A and A^-1, which generate the same subgroup of Gamma_p (by construction; not part of the Lean statement). The lifted holonomy groups <delta^2 g> and <delta^2 g^-1> are conjugate in G~ but not equal. Under the literal G~ reading of OQ-120 (b) with EQUAL lifted holonomy groups, the remark's own argument cannot produce such a pair. A circle's canonical generator has positive degree, so equal lifted groups mean equal lifted holonomy. For one oriented theta, the sign is then decided by the direction in which g moves the future time-like directions (GX.timelike_spacelike_dir), so the two circles have the same sign. This is argued, not formalized. Which notion of « the same holonomy » is of record for the « does not extend » half: conjugate in G~ (the reading taken), equal in Gamma_p, or equal in G~? This bears on OQ-120 (b).

The degree of the examples. The remark names no degree. Positive/negative is defined only for degree k >= 1 (l.906), and the degree is even at p in dS2 (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.even_of_nonneg), so 2 is the least possible degree. The examples are built in degree 2. The statement of GX.exists_positive_negative carries the degree only through IsSpacelikePositive/Negative (k >= 1), not as « = 2 ». The same construction with delta^(2m) g gives every even degree; this is argued, not formalized.

kb_proposals: A lift with a fixed point of a non-trivial A in Gamma_p at p in dS2 is GX.exists_gammaP_lift_fixed. A != 1 exists by contradiction with GX.fixedPoints_subset_of_deSitter at a future time-like direction. Its exists_rayLift lift F fixes the lift t1 of a null ray up to 2n (smul_eq_of_deSitter, linkCover_eq_linkCover_iff), so g = delta^(-2n) * F fixes t1. g is hyperbolic by isHyperbolic_of_linkCover; that g is not central follows from A moving a time-like direction.

A (Gamma_p, l(p))-circle with lifted holonomy delta^2 g (g a lift of A with a fixed point) is GX.exists_isLiftedDev_delta_sq_mul. It returns the fields (cs, hcs, hL) and (GammaLinkCircle.mk p cs hcs hL).IsLiftedDev theta E D (delta^(2:Z) * g), so C.pt = p by rfl. It uses exists_gammaLinkCircle_quotient_of_forall_lt with D = linkCover, hlt from sub_one_lt_apply_of_fixed, and hDf from linkCover_add_two_mul.

To state an RP1-isomorphism between the underlying RP1-circles of two GammaLinkCircles inside an existential, put `letI := C.rp1ChartedSpace θ; haveI := C.rp1_hasGroupoid θ` (and the same for C') in the statement itself. IsRP1Iso needs both the ChartedSpace and the HasGroupoid instances. The proof is (rp1Iso_iff_conj ⟨E, D, h.isLiftedDevPair⟩ ⟨E', D', h'.isLiftedDevPair⟩).2 (GX.exists_rp1Iso_not_isIso).
